paragraphs: He was Rav Yehudah’s attendant, as stated explicitly in Taanit 24b.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Taanit24b scalar names Rav Yehudah and Rav Kahana son of Rav Nechunya, his attendant. It supports the source’s attendant relationship and titles. As stated explicitly remains Hyman’s characterization; no surrounding event is added.
